system.disclosure: The Oryx Institute NQF track is built for formal vocational delivery and pre-accreditation submission. Formal vocational training programmes commence only after NTA provider registration has been granted; NQA accreditation for registered qualifications is pursued in parallel and will be announced on the public register. Current commercial offerings are fee-for-service corporate training under services agreements.

levels.title: Foundation Workplace Health & Safety

modules.title: What occupational safety is and why it matters
modules.focus: The purpose of managed safety and what 'duty of care' means for a general worker.

modules.title: Legal duties of employer and employee
modules.focus: Labour Act 11 of 2007 duties: safe workplace, cooperation, reporting.

modules.title: Hazard identification and reporting
modules.focus: Hazard families, spotting them, and the reporting loop that closes them.

modules.title: Personal protective equipment
modules.focus: PPE types, limits, fit, care and the rule that PPE is the last line.

modules.title: Emergency procedures
modules.focus: Fire, first aid and evacuation basics: alarms, assembly, roll call.

modules.title: Manual handling and basic ergonomics
modules.focus: Load limits, lifting technique, workstation adjustment and fatigue.

levels.assessment: 20-question multiple-choice paper, 80% pass; Certificate of Attendance (internal, non-NQF until accreditation).

levels.title: Workplace SHE Representative & Risk Control

modules.title: The Namibian legal framework
modules.focus: Labour Act 11 of 2007, GN 156 of 1997 and sector regulations in depth.

modules.title: Hazard identification and risk assessment (HIRA)
modules.focus: 5×5 matrix methodology, baseline and task assessments, control hierarchy.

modules.title: Incident investigation and reporting
modules.focus: Near-miss to fatality: procedure, documentation, evidence.

modules.title: PPE inspection and management
modules.focus: Selection, issue registers, inspection schedules, retirement criteria.

modules.title: Emergency preparedness and fire safety
modules.focus: Plans, extinguisher practical, evacuation command.

modules.title: First aid awareness
modules.focus: Awareness scope only — certification sits with the partnered first-aid provider.

modules.title: Construction-site safety
modules.focus: Scaffolds, heights, excavation, electrical awareness; SA instruments labelled as good practice.

modules.title: Toolbox talks and safety meetings
modules.focus: Facilitation skills, agendas, records.

modules.title: Safety file management and documentation
modules.focus: File structure, registers, appointments, audit readiness.

modules.title: Practical site walkthrough assessment
modules.focus: Assessed inspection on a live or simulated site.

levels.assessment: 50-question written exam (30 MCQ + 20 short), 3 practical rubrics (risk assessment, toolbox talk, walkthrough); Certificate of Completion.

modules.title: Occupational hygiene

modules.title: Contractor management

modules.title: Incident investigation (ICAM fundamentals)

modules.title: Auditing and inspection programmes
modules.focus: Audit cycles, findings, corrective action tracking.

modules.title: Training of trainers
modules.focus: Adult learning, session design, credential requirements for instructors.

levels.assessment: Per-module papers (8 × 8 questions) plus management-system assignment and practical audit assignment with rubrics.
